### Power Point - March 30, 2006
Author: PowerPoint Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/power-point-march-30-2006-1386384.html
Passage: Acts 12:5-8
Points:
- Personal trials such as illness, loneliness, or depression can feel like confining prisons.
- God specializes in creating a path forward when human circumstances seem impossible.
- The Lord works powerfully through His Word and through constant, dedicated prayer.
- Believers must commit time to pray for their own perseverance and for those around them.
- Seeking God earnestly in prayer brings divine peace, direction, and strength.

### Miracles, Means And Manna
Author: Paul Carter
Site: The Gospel Coalition Canada
URL: https://ca.thegospelcoalition.org/columns/ad-fontes/miracles-means-manna/
Passage: Acts 12:10
Points:
- When human strength is exhausted, believers must bring impossibly dire situations to God in prayer.
- God miraculously unlocked doors and led Peter out, but the angel departed immediately upon reaching the street.
- Miracles are given when nothing else will do, rather than to replace ordinary effort and human ingenuity.
- Just as wilderness manna ceased in the promised land, supernatural intervention gives way to faithful industriousness.
- Christians should maintain a balanced faith that honors ordinary means while trusting God for extraordinary deliverance.

### R.A. Torrey: Prevailing Prayer
Author: Bob Paulson
Site: Billy Graham Evangelistic Association
URL: https://billygraham.org/decision-magazine/articles/r-a-torrey-prevailing-prayer
Passage: Acts 12:5
Points:
- True prevailing prayer requires a conscious, focused approach directly into God's presence.
- Effective intercession involves intense, wholehearted desire rather than absentminded routine petitions.
- Believers must depend on the Holy Spirit to teach them how to fight the fight of faith.
- Fasting during critical trials demonstrates earnest devotion and single-minded pursuit of God.
- Irresistible power occurs when united believers pray in true spiritual agreement.

### How Peter’s Prison Escape Shows Us the Power of Prayer
Author: Emma Danzey
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/how-peters-prison-escape-shows-us-the-power-of-prayer.html
Passage: Acts 12:5-19
Points:
- Peter’s past walk with Christ gave him deep confidence and peace even while chained in prison.
- Earnest corporate prayer by believers moves God to intervene in seemingly hopeless moments.
- Walking out through the opened iron gate mirrors the rescue and spiritual freedom Christ secures for us.
- Rhoda’s report reveals how often believers pray fervently yet react with disbelief when God actually answers.
- Herod’s fatal wrath toward the guards underscores the tragedy of following worldly power instead of the Savior.
